👑 RONIN — Unbreakable Resolve | ROLG Major 2025 Pre-Match Interview! 👑

"As Ronin, we stand united and strike as one — our resolve is unbreakable."

💥 Get to know RONIN, a proud and disciplined guild ready to fight with heart and honor at the ROLG Major 2025 — the fiercest 10v10 guild clash in Ragnarok Landverse: Genesis.

We spoke with Odinson, and here’s what he had to say:
🎤 Q: How has your guild been preparing for the ROLG Major 2025?
⚔️ Odinson: Our team has been practicing very hard for the ROLG Major 2025. We will do our best.

🎤 Q: What’s your main goal for this event?
⚔️ Odinson:  For this competition, victory may not be the only goal we will achieve.
Friendships and good experiences are also important.
But of course, finishing in the top three is something we will fight hard for.

🎤 Q: Which guild do you see as your biggest rival?
⚔️ Odinson:  Aside from thea Fi Guild, which I consider to be a small guild, the other guilds all seem big and respectable. (Pharaoh's Answer)

🎤 Q: How do you keep morale high during tough matches?
⚔️ Odinson:  Tough matches? We call those “warm-ups.”

🎤 Q: What should other teams be careful about when facing RONIN?
⚔️ Odinson:  OneQ is our secret weapon, watch out for him, he might give you a lot of points.

🎤 Q: Message to your fans?
⚔️ Odinson: To all our fans in the Philippines and Thailand
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your unwavering support.
Your cheers give us the strength to keep moving forward,
and your passion lights the fire that drives us to fight harder.

🎤 Q: One word your rivals should remember?
⚔️ Odinson:  Friendship.

🎤 Q: One emoji to describe your strategy?
⚔️ Odinson: 👊

🔥 RONIN is entering the battlefield with unity, grit, and a secret weapon. Are the other guilds ready?
